items:
Gather your crew and get ready for an unforgettable group escape at Tidal Wave, where relaxation meets fun in the heart of Destin! This stunning 7-bedroom retreat is just a couple of blocks from the pristine white sands of the Gulf, offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience.

The interior greets you with an open floor plan and chic style. Meals are a breeze in the sleek, fully equipped kitchen, where the spacious counters and barstool seating invite you to sip coffee or whip up your favorite brunch. A dining area sets the scene for memorable meals, while a cozy breakfast nook provides plenty of space for everyone.

Step outside to discover a private backyard oasis. Dive into the sparkling pool for a refreshing swim, soak in the hot tub under the stars, or lounge poolside with a good book and a cool drink. The firepit surrounded by colorful Adirondack chairs sets the stage for laid-back evenings filled with laughter and s'mores. A covered patio with a grill and a dining table awaits for evening BBQs amongst the sunset skies.

Inside, the modern and chic design flows effortlessly throughout the home. With 7 spacious bedrooms, there’s room for everyone to unwind. Each room is thoughtfully decorated, ensuring a restful retreat after days filled with sun and adventure.

The prime location is a dream come true. Just a short walk away, the beach awaits for afternoons of sunbathing, sandcastle building, and catching the waves. Plus, the best of Destin’s shops, restaurants, and attractions are right at your fingertips.

Tidal Wave is the ultimate destination for group getaways, family reunions, or a week of coastal bliss with friends. Book your stay today and experience everything this vibrant home has to offer!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

Local Attractions: Destin Commons, Silversands Outlets, Crab Island, Dolphin Tours, Charter Offshore Fishing, Big Kahuna’s Water and Adventure Park, Crackings., Louisiana Lagniappe, Jackacuda’s Seafood + Sushi

Located in Northwest Florida, Destin is dubbed the “world's luckiest fishing village.” This Emerald Coast city is known for its sparkling white beaches, numerous golf courses, and world-famous fishing. Nearby zipline courses, dolphin cruises, and amusement parks make it a perfect destination for families. Adults and large groups also come here for beach parties during the day and live music at night.

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool/spa heat is a paid feature and must be requested 24-48 hours before the day of check-in.
- Pool/spa heat will not be available for the summer months (April 1 - October 31).

Parking Details:
- 4 parking spaces available in the driveway.
- Free street parking is available nearby.

This home comes with a pack n' play travel crib available. A high chair can be provided upon request with at least 24hrs advanced notice.

---

The room configurations are as follows:
Primary Bedroom / Twin bunk bed
Bedroom 2 / Queen bed
Bedroom 3 (Primary bedroom) / King bed w/ Ensuite
Bedroom 4 / King bed w/ Ensuite
Bedroom 5 / Queen bed
Bedroom 6 / King bed
Bedroom 7 / 2 Full beds

---

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff. We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
